blockingDiagnostics.message: No released trusted contributor can aggregate the seven completed WorkItemVerification and ChangeIntegration observations into one standardized TraceabilityUpdate without inventing a new authority or ownership scope.

Each completed run work item has a BootstrapWorkItemHostIntegrationReceipt and IntegratedCompletionFact, but not the exact canonical ChangeIntegration source closure required by devrelay.change-integration@1.0.0: ModuleResult, IntegratedChangeRecord, VerifiedWorkItemSubject, ChangeIntegrationTraceabilityInput, IntegrationInputBinding, post RepositorySnapshot, and their exact referenced WorkItem and ChangeSet artifacts.

The released contributor registry contains no WorkExecution contributor capable of projecting execution-attempt or implementation evidence from BootstrapWorkExecutionTaskContract and BootstrapWorkItemHandoff artifacts.
